prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a vibrant, whimsical animated movie poster in the style of a modern Disney film. The central character is a cheerful, slightly chubby police officer in a classic blue uniform, complete with a badge, cap, and utility belt. He stands confidently in the middle of a sunny suburban backyard, holding a large spatula in one hand. On either side of him are two round charcoal grills, both open and filled with sizzling, cartoonishly exaggerated food—burgers, hot dogs, and vegetables—emitting playful wisps of steam. The background features a neatly fenced yard with green grass, flowering bushes, and cozy houses under a bright blue sky with fluffy clouds. The color palette is bold and saturated, with warm sunlight casting soft, inviting shadows. The composition is symmetrical, with the officer as the focal point, and the grills framing him. Above, in large, friendly lettering, is the title: “TWO GRILLS ONE COP,” with the Disney logo prominently displayed. The overall mood is lighthearted and comedic, evoking a sense of fun and family-friendly adventure, with a polished, cinematic quality and a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the main character and his grills.
